Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
🦥
Language Sloth is a large language-learning Discord community. This documentation library explains how the community is governed, how rules are enforced fairly, and how official decisions are published and preserved.

What this library is for

Transparency: make the governance structure and decision-making process easy to understand.
Consistency: keep moderation, legal process, and official acts in one canonical place.
Accountability: document responsibilities and procedures so they can be applied predictably.
Continuity: preserve institutional memory as the community grows (staff turnover, new initiatives, new regions).

Community overview
Language Sloth is organized around:

The Discord community: the main social and learning hub.
Marketplace: store.languagesloth.org
Advertising platform: advertise.languagesloth.org

How to use this documentation

If you are new: start with Server rules and Community legal process.
If you are staff: review Government structure first, then use Decrees & Acts / Organic Law for formal decisions.
If you are looking for the “current rules”: treat these pages as canonical references; Discord posts/announcements should link back here.


Governance

🏛️
Defines the institutions of the community, what each role does, and how authority flows.

Government structure

Community Rules & Process

🧩
Practical guidance for day-to-day community behavior and how moderation decisions are handled with fairness.

Server rules
Community legal process

Law & Official Acts

📜
The formal record: ratified rules of the Senate, and official decrees/acts that create or change governance.

Official decrees & ministerial acts
Senate Organic Law

Definitions (quick glossary)

Decree / Ministerial Act: an official instrument used to ratify, create, or modify institutional rules and operational procedures.
Organic Law: a foundational governance text defining competence, procedures, and guardrails (especially for the Senate).
Impeachment proceeding: the formal process for judging alleged abuse or incompatible conduct by a Moderator (as defined in the Organic Law).

Versioning note
When major changes occur, prefer to add a new decree/act and keep older ones archived in the Official decrees & ministerial acts page to preserve historical context.

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Community legal process
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
🧭
This page explains how moderation decisions are made, what evidence is required, and how to appeal — with fairness, consistency, and transparency.

Principles

Presumption of good faith: everyone starts neutral; action is based on evidence.
Evidence-based enforcement: no punishment without verifiable proof.
Proportionality: consequences should match severity and context.
Transparency: decisions should be explainable and consistent.


1) Reports & rule violations
When a rule is broken or a report is filed, Staff may take action.
Report requirements (mandatory):

Provide solid evidence (screenshots, clips, logs, links).
Include context (what happened before/after, dates/times if possible).

If there is no evidence, no punishment is applied.

2) Investigation
Staff may:

Ask questions publicly in the appropriate channels
Temporarily restrict someone (e.g., timeout/mute) to prevent escalation
Collect additional facts before deciding

Decisions should be based on evidence and fairness — not assumptions.

3) Right to assistance (Attorney Mod)
Anyone involved in a case can request an Attorney Mod to assist.
Attorney Mods can:

Help organize evidence
Help write a clear statement/defense
Help keep the process calm and structured


4) Outcomes (punishment ladder)
Typical progression:

⚠️ Warning
⏱️ Timeout
🔨 Ban

Severity may justify skipping steps (e.g., extreme misconduct).

5) Appeals & second chances
Banned users may join the appeal server to request a review.
To be considered, the user should:

Explain their side clearly
Acknowledge the rules
Commit to behavior changes

If they cooperate and accept the rules, they may be unbanned.

6) Repeated bans
If someone is banned again after returning, the only way back is an unban purchase ($10).

Roles in the process

🛡️ Moderators: enforce rules in text and voice channels and handle routine cases.
⚖️ Judge (@makemeport): applies common law and makes decisions based on logic, natural rights, precedents, and guidelines (including bans, unbans, and complex investigations).


Goal
This system exists to protect the community and ensure everyone is treated fairly.

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Government structure
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
---
title: Maiestas Imperii — Imperial Government Structure
---
flowchart TD
     Four branches
    CHAN --> SEN
    CHAN --> TRIB
    CHAN --> MAG
    CHAN --> OFF

     Tribunicia Potestas — Executive Power
    subgraph TRIB["⚔ Tribunicia Potestas — Executive Power"]
        CONS["**Consul**"]
        CAPM["**Captain Moderator**"]
        MODER["**Moderator**"]
        CONS --> CAPM --> MODER
    end

     Magister Officiorum — Ministries to the People
    subgraph OFF["📜 Magister Officiorum — Ministries to the People"]
        MCIV["**Minister of Civil House**"]
        MLES["**Minister of Lessons**"]
        MCOD["**Minister of Code**"]
        TEACH["**Teachers**"]
        MLES --> TEACH
    end

    %% Users — governed by Legislature & Executive
    SENAT --> USERS["**Users**"]
    MODER --> USERS


Overview
This document defines the structure of the Language Sloth Community governance system and each institution’s responsibilities.
Branches (summary)

Apex (Imperial Power): The Khan and the Chancellor
Legislative Power: The Senate
Executive Power: Tribunicia Potestas
Judicial Power: Magistratus
Ministries: Magister Officiorum
Users: The foundation of the entire system


Imperial Power (Maiestas Imperii)
The Khan
The Khan is the supreme authority and guardian of the system. The Imperial Power supports all branches and is responsible for the overall stability and direction of the community.
The Imperial Power normally does not interfere in daily moderation or administration. Its main role is to work in expansion projects, maintain balance between the branches, and intervene only in extraordinary situations such as:

Major conflicts
Institutional crises
Serious disputes
Critical community matters

The Chancellor
The Chancellor supports the administration and bureaucracy of the system.
Responsibilities include:

Organizing information
Investigating situations
Handling reports
Assisting communication between branches
Improving speed and accuracy in operations
Changing the structure of the server internally on Discord


Legislative Power — The Senate
Purpose
The Senate exists to prevent abuse of power and represent the interests of the users.
The Senate may:

Audit the staff
Review executive decisions
Investigate abuses
Recommend reforms and updates
Discuss important community matters
Vote on disciplinary or structural actions

The Senate is also responsible for listening to the community regarding:

Suggestions
Feedback
Server improvements
User concerns

Roles
President of the Senate

Organizes and leads meetings, discussions, debates, votes, and Senate procedures.

Senators

Represent the community and help supervise the integrity of the system.


Executive Power (Tribunicia Potestas)
The Consul
The Consul is the highest executive authority.
Responsibilities include:

Training moderators
Promoting or demoting moderators
Organizing moderation teams
Handling complex cases
Maintaining discipline inside the staff

The Consul also acts as the bridge between the moderation team and the Senate.
Captain Moderators
Captain Moderators are experienced regional leaders responsible for maintaining order in their teams and assigned world regions.
They:

Train newer moderators
Supervise teams
Maintain discipline
Recommend promotions or punishments
Support stability inside the executive branch

Moderators
Moderators enforce the rules and help users daily.
They:

Handle reports
Resolve conflicts
Assist users
Enforce server rules
Maintain a healthy and stable community

They work independently on moderation cases and user support.

Judicial Power — The Magistratus
Minister of Justice
The Minister of Justice is the highest judicial authority.
Responsibilities include:

Interpreting rules
Issuing bans and unbans
Defining how rules are applied
Creating precedents through decisions
Ensuring fairness and consistency

The Minister of Justice is the final interpreter of the community’s legal framework.
Attorneys
Attorneys are helper users who may defend or speak on behalf of users involved in:

Reports
Investigations
Senate discussions
Serious disciplinary cases

Their purpose is to ensure fairness and representation.

Ministries (Magister Officiorum)
Purpose
The Ministries are independent entities that work for the development and improvement of the community.
They support the Imperial Power through projects, education, and specialized services.
Teachers
Teachers are volunteer users responsible for educational activities and classes inside the community.
They may:

Organize classes
Teach subjects
Guide users
Help develop community knowledge


Users
Users are the foundation of the entire system. Every institution exists to serve and protect the community.
Users may:

Report rule violations
Make suggestions
Help improve the server
Support other users
Participate in community growth

The purpose of the system is to ensure that users feel:

Safe
Connected
Heard
Respected
Happy within the community

Subject: Civil House — Ratification of the Senate Organic Law

Decree No. 001/2026 — Civil House
OFFICIAL DECREE
Khanate of the Great Khan
1st Act of the Minister of the Civil House
Ratification of the New Organic Law of the Senate
I, Marescallus Zanella (Biaggioni), Minister of the Civil House of Internal Relations, duly empowered by the Great Khan, DECREE:

Article 1 — The changes and updates contained in the New Organic Law of the Senate are hereby officially ratified and approved.
Article 2 — This Decree enters into force on May 20, 2026.
Article 3 — The President of the Senate shall have a period of two (2) days, counting from May 20, 2026, to formally notify all Senators of the full content of the New Organic Law and of this Decree.
Article 4 — All Senators and administrative bodies of the Khanate shall comply with the provisions of the New Organic Law from the date of its entry into force.

LET IT BE FULFILLED
Issued on the 18th day of May, 2026.
Signed and sealed:

Chancellor of the Great Khan (signature on record)
For and on behalf of His Eminence the Great Khan (signature on record)

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: MINISTERIAL ACT Nº 05 2026 The Code of Conduct, Rights and Duties of Moderation
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
MINISTERIAL ACT Nº 05/2026 (With Immediate Effect)
The Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations, in use of the powers granted
by Khanate Decree Nº 001/2026, Article 4,
MAKES KNOWN to all Moderators, Captain Moderators and Staff members:
Art. 1º – The Code of Conduct, Rights and Duties of Moderation of Language
Sloth is hereby approved and instituted.
CODE OF CONDUCT, RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF MODERATION
Chapter I – General Principles
Art. 2º – The Moderator acts as a Sheriff of the community: maintains order, deescalates conflicts, enforces rules at a surface level and leads by example.
Art. 3º – The Moderator is not a judge. Their role is to act preventively and with
good sense, escalating serious cases to higher levels.
Chapter II – Tools and Procedures
Art. 4º – Available tools for Moderators:
• Warn — Command: x!warn ID (reason)
• Mute — Command: x!mute ID (reason)
• Timeout — Command: x!timeout ID (reason)
• Ban — Command: x!ban ID (reason)
§ 1º – The Ban tool must be used with extreme caution, as it is a high-impact
measure. § 2º – Although the Moderator may execute the command, final
approval must come from Administrators or higher levels. § 3º – All moderation
actions must be evidenced in the evidencias channel, with full record of the
infraction and the command used.
Chapter III – Captain Moderators
Art. 5º – Regional Captain Moderators are responsible for coordinating,
supervising and leading a specific group of Moderators in their designated region.
Art. 6º – Duties of Captain Moderators:
• Coordinate the team of Moderators under their responsibility;
• Receive and analyze weekly reports;
• Guide, train and give feedback;
• Resolve minor internal disputes;
• Forward serious cases to Administrators or Ministers.
Chapter IV – Moderation Hierarchy
Art. 7º – The operational hierarchy of Moderation is as follows:
Khan → Chancellor → Ministers/Administrators → Regional Captain Moderators
→ Moderators
Art. 8º – The Senate does not form part of this chain of command. The Senate
acts as an Independent Review House of the conduct of Moderators (the “police”
of the community), functioning in a separate and honorable manner, with the aim
of ensuring balance, justice and the proper functioning of the Khanate’s
institutions.
Chapter V – Final Provisions
Art. 9º – Violation of this Code may result in warning, performance review or
impeachment representation in the Senate.
Art. 10º – This Code enters into force immediately on the date of its publication
and revokes any previous incompatible provisions.
Let it be published and complied with.
Done on May 18, 2026.
IN THE NAME OF THE GREAT KHAN IN THE NAME OF GOD
Marescallus Zanella (Biaggioni) Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations
Executive Officer of the Khanate

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Ministerial Act 02 2026 — Vicariate order
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
📜
Document type: Ministerial Act
Number: 02/2026
Subject: Vicariate order in case of the Great Khan’s absence

Ministerial Act No. 02/2026
THE MINISTER OF CIVIL AFFAIRS AND INTERNAL RELATIONS AND EXECUTIVE OFFICER OF THE KHANATE, in exercise of the powers granted by the Great Khan, HEREBY DECLARES that the following order of vicariate is established in case of the Great Khan’s absence:

Article 1 — In the event of the Great Khan’s self-declared absence, the Chancellor shall act as Vicar for the entire period of absence.
Article 2 — The Vicar shall enjoy all legal prerogatives and powers of the Great Khan during this period and must exercise them with loyalty and in the best interest of the Khanate.
Article 3 — The Great Khan may, at any time, suspend the effects of the vicariate, in whole or in part. All acts performed under the vicariate shall be considered derogated as soon as the Great Khan returns to functions.
Article 4 — In the simultaneous absence of both the Great Khan and the Chancellor, the function of Vicar shall be exercised successively by:

I. The Consul
II. The Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations
III. The Minister of Justice


Article 5 — This Ministerial Act enters into force on the date of its publication.

Let it be published, registered, and complied with.
Issued on May 18, 2026.
Marescallus Zanella (Biaggioni)
Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations
Executive Officer of the Khanate

Number: 03/2026
Subject: Admission of three new Senators

Ministerial Act No. 03/2026 (Immediate effect)
The Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations, in use of the powers granted by Khanate Decree No. 001/2026 (especially Article 4), MAKES KNOWN to the President of the Senate the following:

Art. 1 — The admission of 3 (three) new Senators to the Senate is hereby determined, which shall occur in the coming days.
Art. 2 — The new Senators shall be appointed by:

The Ministers of the Khanate, or
Directly by the Great Khan, on their own merit.


Art. 3 — The inclusion of the three new Senators aims to increase the Senate’s quorum, providing greater representativeness and agility to deliberations.
Art. 4 — Once sworn in, the new Senators shall, as from May 20, 2026 (date of entry into force of the Senate Organic Law), declare knowledge of the said Organic Law within a maximum period of 48 hours.
Art. 5 — This Ministerial Act enters into force immediately on the date of its publication.
Art. 6 — This act is provisional and subject to ratification, modification, or revocation by the Great Khan at any time.

Let it be published and complied with.

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Ministerial Act 04 2026 — Weekly moderator reporting
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
📜
Document type: Ministerial Act (Immediate effect)
Number: 04/2026
Subject: Weekly reporting procedure for Moderators

Ministerial Act No. 04/2026 (Immediate effect)
The Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations, in use of the powers granted by Khanate Decree No. 001/2026 (Article 4), MAKES KNOWN to all Moderators and Captain Moderators:

Art. 1 — After each weekly update of the activity panel, every Moderator may report directly to their respective Regional Captain Moderator. Although not mandatory, it is strongly recommended that they do so weekly in order to:

Maintain the good functioning of moderation
Enable quick feedback
Identify problems early
Strengthen teamwork


Art. 2 — In this report, the Moderator may present:

Criticisms
Compliments
Complaints or suggestions


Art. 3 — The Regional Captain Moderator has the duty to receive, analyze, and resolve the issues presented, acting with agility and fairness.
Art. 4 — In cases of serious disputes that cannot be resolved at the Captain level, it is strongly recommended that they be forwarded to the Administrators and Ministers or, if there is reason for punishment, that a representation for impeachment be filed in the Senate.
Art. 5 — This reporting procedure, although flexible, is essential for the continuous improvement of moderation.
Art. 6 — This act is provisional and subject to ratification, modification, or revocation by the Great Khan at any time.

Let it be published and complied with.
Done on May 18, 2026.
IN THE NAME OF THE GREAT KHAN
IN THE NAME OF GOD
Marescallus Zanella (Biaggioni)
Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations
Executive Officer of the Khanate

Ministerial Act No. 06/2026 (Immediate effect)
The Minister of Civil Affairs and Internal Relations, in use of the powers granted by Khanate Decree No. 001/2026 (Article 4), MAKES KNOWN to all Administrators, Captain Moderators, and Staff members:

Art. 1 — The following Regional Captaincies of Moderation are hereby created, with open positions to be filled:

Regional Captaincy of Japan
Regional Captaincy of the British Isles


Art. 2 — The positions above shall be filled according to the following mandatory technical criteria:

Fluently speak the language of the region (Japanese for the Japan Captaincy, English for the British Isles Captaincy)

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Senate Organic Law
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
Senate Organic Law
Ratified version approved by the Great Khan
(Prepared at the request of the Great Khan for ratification by the Minister of the Civil House)

Title I — Nature and Jurisdiction

Art. 1 The Senate is the collegiate body responsible for adjudicating impeachment proceedings against Moderators accused of:

Abuse of power
Serious disrespect toward the system and government of the community, including serious disrespect of the established hierarchy
Conduct incompatible with the position


Art. 2 The Senate has autonomy to judge proceedings, fully respecting the provisions of this Organic Law.


Title II — Impeachment Proceedings

Art. 3 Every impeachment proceeding must have formal records (a complete file), containing:

A written, well-grounded complaint
Identification of the accused and the facts
Evidence submitted
Official notice to the Moderator
The defense of the accused
The report and votes of the Senators
The final decision


Art. 4 The President of the Senate may, on their own initiative or upon request, dismiss the proceeding for manifest irrelevance or manifest lack of evidence.

§1 When dismissing, the President must publish a brief report in the senado channel explaining the reasons.
§2 The dismissal may be reversed by a simple majority of Senators within 48 hours.


Art. 5 The defense of the accused and adversarial proceedings should preferably take place in the congresso channel.

§1 In serious cases, the President may determine that the defense and adversarial proceedings take place in a reserved channel (#senado or another private channel), ensuring transparency to Senators and preserving the dignity of the accused.
§2 The decision to change channels must be justified and communicated in senado.


Art. 6 Senators are expressly forbidden from talking to the accused Moderator by DM about the proceeding.

Sole paragraph: all official interaction with the accused must be conducted in the channels defined by this Law.


Art. 7 Senate deliberations, votes, and internal discussions shall occur exclusively in the senado channel.


Title III — President of the Senate

Art. 8 The President of the Senate serves a term of 2 (two) years.

§1 The current term shall last at most until April 1, 2028.
§2 The President may resign at any time by formally communicating it in senado.


Art. 9 Election and re-election shall occur by simple majority vote, with full quorum.
Art. 10 The term may be extended or maintained by the express will of the Great Khan.
Art. 11 The President may be removed from office for:

Inertia or unjustified absence
Incompatible conduct
§1 Removal shall be carried out exclusively by the Great Khan.
§2 The Great Khan may remove the President at any time due to force majeure, without the need for public justification.




Title IV — Operational Rules

Art. 12 Senate deliberations, debates, and votes shall be conducted in the senado channel.
Art. 13 The congresso channel is intended primarily for the defense and statements of the accused.
Art. 14 The President of the Senate has the following duties:

Preside over sessions in senado
Receive complaints
Decide dismissals and channel transfers (with notice in senado)
Maintain order
Cast the tie-breaking vote

Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.title: Server rules
Language-Sloth/Language-Sloth-Community-.content:
Server rules (quick guide)

📌
Purpose: Keep this community safe, welcoming, and useful for everyone.
Rules apply to public channels, voice channels, DMs started via this server, usernames, nicknames, avatars, bios, and external links shared here.

Community standards

No NSFW / graphic content

No porn, nudity, sexual content, gore, or shock content.


Respect & dignity

No racism, sexism, hate speech, harassment, doxxing, threats, or targeted humiliation.
Keep swearing reasonable and context-appropriate.


Controversial topics

Politics, religion, and similar topics belong in the designated debate channel only.
Do not use profiles (name, bio, avatar) to provoke or campaign.


No shameless plugging / spammy self-promo

No unsolicited ads, repetitive promotion, referral links, or “drive-by” marketing.
Ask Staff first if you want to share a project, event, or opportunity.


Privacy & consent

Do not share personal information about others without explicit consent.
No recording voice chats or reposting screenshots without permission from everyone involved.


No spam or disruption

No flooding channels, excessive pings, reaction spam, or disruptive soundboards in voice.


No impersonation

Do not pretend to be another user, Staff, or a public figure.


No begging for power

Do not ask for roles like moderator/teacher. Use official applications when available.


No drama farming

Don’t stir conflict for entertainment. If something escalates, disengage and open a ticket.


Security & common sense

Never pressure anyone to download files, run scripts, or “verify” accounts. Social engineering = ban.



Enforcement (fair process)

Staff may remove content, issue warnings, mute, kick, or ban depending on severity and repetition.
If you believe a moderation action was mistaken, open a ticket and provide context. Be respectful—appeals are reviewed.

Legal & rights considerations (plain-language)

Common law principles (fairness): We aim to act with reasonableness, consistency, and proportionality. Repeat or severe misconduct is treated more seriously than minor mistakes.
Fundamental rights (respectful baseline): We protect the community’s basic interests—safety, privacy, reputation, freedom of speech and freedom from harassment. At the same time, we support good-faith expression in the right place and tone.
No “rights” to harm: Speech that targets people (harassment, hate speech, threats, doxxing) is not protected here and will be moderated.
Due process mindset: When possible, we explain what happened, which rule applies, and what to do next—especially for first-time or low-severity issues.
